title: Mithi Peanut (BPI Pn 2): Yield, Maturity and Characteristics
metaTitle: Mithi Peanut: Yield, Maturity and Characteristics
metaDescription: Mithi peanut is a peanut variety. 97 to 101 days to harvest, 1.8 t/ha in trials. See its ratings and traits. Compare it with others.
excerpt: Mithi is a registered peanut variety, also sold or known as BPI Pn 2. The Philippine Seed Board approved it in 1989. It takes 97 to 101 days from sowing to harvest, with 1.79 tonnes per hectare on average in the trials.

items: **Days to harvest:** 97 to 101 days from sowing to harvest.
**Yield:** 1.79 tonnes per hectare on average in the trials.

blocks.text: How long does it take, and how much does it yield?

Mithi peanut takes 97 to 101 days from sowing to harvest. That is about the average of the 26 peanut varieties with a day count, 101.3 days. A shorter crop frees the field sooner and dodges more of the weather, while a longer one often fills more.

Its average yield of 1.79 t/ha trails the average of its group, 1.85. Trial yields come from well managed plots, so your own will depend on water, fertilizer, pests and timing.

Once you know the day count, anee.io dates every task from each lot's own planting day, with [the growth stages and weather](/features/growth-stages-and-weather) beside it.
Is it resistant to pests and diseases?

blocks.text: It showed no weak spot in the ratings on record. Still, a resistant variety can break down when a new strain or pest population comes, so keep scouting.

The pests and diseases that hit peanut fields most often: [bacterial wilt](/diseases/bacterial-wilt), [eggplant leafhopper](/pests/eggplant-leafhopper), [bean fly](/pests/bean-fly), [Corn earworm](/pests/corn-earworm), [cutworm](/pests/cutworm). Our [pest finder](/pests) and [disease finder](/diseases) help you name what you see.
Where and when to plant Mithi peanut
Mani needs loose, well drained soil to fill its pods. Pick a variety by seed size for your buyer, and one rated against rust and leaf spot for the wet season.

items.q: Is BPI Pn 2 the same as Mithi?
items.a: Yes. BPI Pn 2 is another name for Mithi. Seed sellers use both, so ask for either one.

items.q: How long does it take to harvest?
items.a: It takes 97 to 101 days from sowing to harvest. Then the weather and your care decide the exact day.
The record shows 1.79 tonnes per hectare on average in the trials. Your own yield depends on the soil, water, fertilizer and pests on your farm.

items.q: Where can I buy seed of Mithi?
items.a: Ask an accredited seed dealer in your province, the seller named on this page or your municipal agriculturist. Look for the certified seed tag or a sealed pack before you pay.
